description: This is a PHP source file for a controller class named Gdpr in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class handles GDPR-related actions such as displaying information, processing GDPR requests, and updating GDPR statuses for customers.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for GDPR-related actions, extending the core Controller class from the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the GDPR information page; loads the GDPR info and displays the page if GDPR info exists.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles GDPR request actions such as export, remove, and denial via POST request; processes the request, updates GDPR status, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a success page after a GDPR-related action has been completed, based on a provided code.
